definitionBean.title: Distance Formula (Distance Formula)
definitionBean.definition: दो pointओं P(x1,y1) and Q(x2,y2) between of distance: PQ = √[(x2-x1)² + (y2-y1)²]
definitionBean.explanation: यह formula Pythagorean theorem at आधारित है। coordinates तल at किन्हीं दो pointओं between of सीधी distance ज्ञात करने for its प्रsum is, जो त्रिभुज या चतुर्भुज of प्रकृति पहचानने in भी सहायक है।
importantPoints: यह Pythagorean theorem at आधारित है

definitionBean.title: Section Formula (Section Formula)
definitionBean.definition: If point P divides line segment AB in the ratio m:n, then the coordinates of P are: [(mx2+nx1)/(m+n), (my2+ny1)/(m+n)]
definitionBean.explanation: यह formula किसी line segment को दिए गए ratio in बाँटने वाले point of coordinates ज्ञात करने for प्रsum is। जब point Midpoint हो (ratio 1:1) then formula Midpoint formula बन जाता है।
importantPoints: यह त्रिभुज of माध्यिof व ofन्द्रक ज्ञात करने in उपsumी है

definitionBean.title: Area of Triangle using Coordinates (Area of Triangle using Coordinates)
definitionBean.definition: The area of a triangle with coordinates (x1,y1), (x2,y2), (x3,y3) = ½ |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)|
definitionBean.explanation: यह formula त्रिभुज of तीनों शीर्षों of coordinates ज्ञात when सीधे area निofलने for प्रsum is। if obtained area शून्य आए, then तीनों point collinear (collinear) होते हैं।
importantPoints: area शून्य when point collinear होते हैं
area सदैव धनात्मक लिया जाता है (absolute value)

parts.statement: pointओं of निम्नलिखित युग्मों between of दूरियाँ find: (2, 3) and (4, 1)
parts.explanation:
Let point P(2, 3) and Q(4, 1) हैं।
Here x1 = 2, y1 = 3 and x2 = 4, y2 = 1

Using the distance formula:
PQ = √[(x2 - x1)² + (y2 - y1)²]
PQ = √[(4 - 2)² + (1 - 3)²]
PQ = √[(2)² + (-2)²]
PQ = √[4 + 4] = √8
PQ = 2√2 units

parts.statement: वह point find जो pointओं (-1, 7) and (4, -3) को मिलाने वाले line segment को 2:3 of ratio in विभाजित करता है।
parts.explanation:
Let वांछित point P(x, y) है।
Here x1 = -1, y1 = 7 and x2 = 4, y2 = -3
ratio m : n = 2 : 3

Using the section formula:
x = (mx2 + nx1) / (m + n) = [2(4) + 3(-1)] / (2 + 3) = (8 - 3) / 5 = 5 / 5 = 1
y = (my2 + ny1) / (m + n) = [2(-3) + 3(7)] / (2 + 3) = (-6 + 21) / 5 = 15 / 5 = 3

Therefore required point (1, 3) है।

parts.statement: pointओं (1, -1) and (-4, 6) को मिलाने वाले line segment को किस ratio in विभाजित करता है? (if point (-1, 6) विभाजित करता हो या सामान्य विभाजन प्रश्न)
parts.correct_answer: line segment को विभाजित करने वाले point of coordinates find जो it 2:1 in बांटता है (Let pointओं (4, -3) and (8, 5) को 3:1)
parts.explanation:
Let point A(4, -3) and B(8, 5) हैं, and आंतरिक रूप from 3:1 of ratio in विभाजित करने वाले point of coordinates ज्ञात करने हैं।
x = [3(8) + 1(4)] / (3 + 1) = (24 + 4) / 4 = 28 / 4 = 7
y = [3(5) + 1(-3)] / (3 + 1) = (15 - 3) / 4 = 12 / 4 = 3
Therefore required point (7, 3) है।

parts.statement: pointओं (5, -6) and (-1, -4) को addने वाले line segment को y-अक्ष किस ratio in विभाजित करता है? this Point of Intersection of coordinates भी find।
parts.explanation:
Let y-अक्ष line segment को k:1 of ratio in विभाजित करता है। Therefore Point of Intersection of coordinates (( -k + 5 ) / (k + 1), (-4k - 6) / (k + 1)) होंगे।
चूँकि point y-अक्ष at है, its x-coordinates 0 होगा:
(-k + 5) / (k + 1) = 0 => -k + 5 = 0 => k = 5
Therefore ratio 5:1 है।
y-coordinates = [-4(5) - 6] / (5 + 1) = (-20 - 6) / 6 = -26 / 6 = -13/3
Therefore Point of Intersection (0, -13/3) है।

parts.statement: उस Area of Triangle using Coordinates find जिसof शीर्ष (2, 3), (-1, 0) and (2, -4) हैं।
parts.explanation:
त्रिभुज of area of formula:
Area = ½ |x1(y2 - y3) + x2(y3 - y1) + x3(y1 - y2)|
Here (x1, y1) = (2, 3), (x2, y2) = (-1, 0), (x3, y3) = (2, -4)

Substituting the values:
Area = ½ |2(0 - (-4)) + (-1)(-4 - 3) + 2(3 - 0)|
Area = ½ |2(4) + (-1)(-7) + 2(3)|
Area = ½ |8 + 7 + 6|
Area = ½ |21| = 21/2 square units

parts.statement: k of मान find if point (7, -2), (5, 1) and (3, k) collinear (collinear) हैं।
parts.explanation:
चूँकि तीनों point collinear हैं, Therefore इनfrom बनने वाले Area of Triangle using Coordinates 0 होगा।
½ |x1(y2 - y3) + x2(y3 - y1) + x3(y1 - y2)| = 0
Here x1 = 7, y1 = -2; x2 = 5, y2 = 1; x3 = 3, y3 = k

7(1 - k) + 5(k - (-2)) + 3((-2) - 1) = 0
7 - 7k + 5(k + 2) + 3(-3) = 0
7 - 7k + 5k + 10 - 9 = 0
(7 + 10 - 9) + (-7k + 5k) = 0
8 - 2k = 0
2k = 8 => k = 4
